tests.name: profile: explicit preference outranks conflicting inference, newer explicit statement supersedes older inference, history is preserved
profile: sensitive inferred items need explicit confirmation, rejection stores nothing, model-declared sensitivity is honored
session end queues a retrospective over exactly that session; approval links evidence and originals stay untouched
session end without a provider queues work that is blocked, never a fabricated summary
critic: duplicate and over-certain dreams are rejected with preserved rationale; no second discovery is stored
critic: a model critic can reject or flag but never approve; critic outages do not block deterministic review
privacy: remote providers never receive private workspace content unless the vault explicitly allows it
budgets, strict schema, sanitized errors, retries and cancellation at the job level
configured Ollama-style endpoint drives a wiki job end to end; output is staged, validated and never written directly
a direct correction supersedes an earlier inferred preference: linked evidence, preserved history, regenerated projection
free-text corrections are detected without a model flag and keep extraction confidence separate from factual certainty
free-text correction reconciles a differently keyed inference by matching the corrected subject
model abstentions are rejected instead of being stored as user insights
profile extraction repairs one schema-invalid model abstention and keeps it rejected
wiki and imported sources show exposure only: they never become a preference, goal, capability or endorsement
agent conclusions never override the user: contradicted ones are rejected, unconfirmed ones need explicit confirmation
workspace-scoped and global preferences coexist without false conflicts
sensitive candidates need confirmation, are never listed in projections or shared indexes, and are visible only to authorized readers
extraction is idempotent, projections are byte-stable, and the source history behind an insight stays reachable
evidence must be real, authorized, content-consistent and correctly attributed; the model cannot raise its own evidence or confidence
passively captured user messages feed profile extraction incrementally, ahead of agent output, without reprocessing
CLI: profile correct, insight search and projection work end to end; agents have no tool to speak for the user

gaps.item: Labeled real-model extraction quality (precision, recall, false-positive rate, schema reliability, scope, provenance)
gaps.reason: Real-model labeled evaluation status FAIL: precision=1, recall=1, falsePositiveRate=0, jobSuccessRate=0.6875, scopeAccuracy=1, evidenceGrounding=1. See verification/profile/real-model-evaluation.json.
A keyword heuristic plus the model's own label; it can miss sensitive content. Nothing is committed without review.

gaps.item: Calibration against external factual truth labels
gaps.reason: Extraction confidence reflects evidence provenance and density; factual certainty is represented separately and does not claim external calibration.

limitations: Insights are user-private by storage ACL; anyone with global:profile:read (or the owner) can read them.
Evidence from a private workspace can support an insight stored in the profile area; the insight text itself is then user-private, not workspace-private.
